## 当前阻塞点

- `blockers`: The c-probe/systemd ttyS0 RX blocker is fixed by the UART read-lane sideband change, the root-shell command path passes on clean kernel through the default wrapper/check-script auto release-delay path, full-package generators-enabled early autocheck passes, exact serial-getty removes the old `/dev/ttyS0` wait, and preseeded sysusers/update-done skips `Create System Users`. The current login/session blocker is now NPC RV64 FMA support: `plymouth` SIGILLs on `fmadd.d`, with udev/module-load/coldplug still visible as the later startup tail.
- `missing_dependencies`: Full Ubuntu completion still needs later multi-user/login/session or equivalent guest-side full gate. The current strongest completed NPC proof is full-package generators-enabled early autocheck plus static full-login rootfs readiness; the strongest attempted login proof is a fail-diagnostic run showing exact serial-getty and sysusers preseed progress before the new `fmadd.d` SIGILL frontier.
- `risk_assessment`: Current PASS is stronger than the earlier staged generator-disabled and interactive gates because it enters the real generators-enabled systemd unit graph with the full package set present, reaches PID1 autocheck, and statically prepares a login marker image. It must not be reported as complete Ubuntu 22.04: the login/PAM marker did not run, and simply increasing the done marker or stopping at the systemd banner would hide the current FMA/udev/module-load frontier.

## 下一步建议

1. Implement and regression-test NPC RV64 FMA (`FMADD/FMSUB/FNMSUB/FNMADD.{S,D}`), then rerun the same preseeded full-login marker gate without widening `__NPC_LOGIN_CHECK_DONE__ rc=0`.
2. Preserve the exact `serial-getty@ttyS0.service` instance check in the rootfs contract, because drop-ins clearing `BindsTo=`/`After=` were not sufficient to remove the `/dev/ttyS0` wait.
3. Add a static/e2e contract for the NPC root-shell command-mode default release-delay behavior and the generators-enabled/login-marker rootfs check path, so future edits cannot silently remove the 20M-cycle console-shell wait rule, enabled-generator contract, or exact serial-getty bypass.
4. Keep the read-lane sideband regression suite in the default NPC focused set, especially `tb_uart`, `tb_axi_lite_to_uart`, `tb_axi_lite_xbar`, `tb_ooo_mem_axi_bridge`, and `tb_ooo_sv39_boot`, because this bug sits at the interface between LSU alignment and UART side effects.
5. Keep completion markers narrow: `__NPC_SYSTEMD_AUTOCHECK_DONE__ rc=0` for early systemd autocheck and `__NPC_LOGIN_CHECK_DONE__ rc=0` for login/PAM marker. Do not reuse wrapper preflight markers or broad done markers for completion.

## 模板升级候选

- `repeated_dynamic_subgraph`: wrapper preflight -> systemd PID1 banner -> early oneshot autocheck -> UART command injection
- `should_promote_to_static_template`: `yes`
- `reason`: NPC Ubuntu progress now needs separate gates for wrapper, PID1, service execution, UART input, and later sysinit; collapsing them into one marker caused false positives.

The wait released at `cycle=669940140` / `commit=371798789`; host popped all 24 bytes through `cycle=672240140` / `commit=372773436`. UART access trace showed matching RBR reads at offset `0x000`, including low bytes `0x5f 0x5f 0x4e ... 0x0a`, and IRQ trace showed UART IRQ + PLIC IRQ assertion/clear around each byte. The systemd autocheck still reached `__NPC_SYSTEMD_AUTOCHECK_DONE__ rc=0`, but no tty reader line/done marker appeared; the run hit `cycles=700000000`, `commits=386235726`, `simulation frequency=232740 inst/s`, and `run.rc=1`.

- `followup_c_probe`: Added static riscv64 guest probe `Linux/tools/ysyx-npc-tty-probe.c` and rootfs mode `UBUNTU_ROOTFS_NPC_TTY_READER_MODE=c-probe`. The rebuilt `ubuntu-22.04-riscv64-tty-reader-c-probe.ext4` passed rootfs readiness, and `/usr/local/sbin/ysyx-npc-tty-probe` is a statically linked riscv64 ELF. Runtime evidence `.github/task-runs/2026-06-16-npc-systemd-real-shell-uart-check/evidence/npc-systemd-tty-reader-c-probe-loop/` shows `__NPC_TTY_C_PROBE_BEGIN__`, raw termios (`iflag=0x6000`, `lflag=0xe30`, `vmin=0`, `vtime=2`), `FIONREAD_BEFORE avail=0`, then `__NPC_TTY_READER_READY__`; host released at `cycle=675737512/commit=385199517` and popped all 24 bytes through `cycle=678037512/commit=386393098`. Every probe poll from iter 0 to 63 reported `rc=0 revents=0x0 avail_before=0 total=0`, followed by `__NPC_TTY_READER_BYTES__:0`, empty hex/line, and `__NPC_TTY_C_PROBE_EMPTY__`. The harness used broad done marker `__NPC_TTY_READER_DONE__`, so `run.rc=0` only means controlled diagnostic stop, not successful byte delivery.
- `followup_kernel_rx_trace`: Initial printk-based kernel RX trace runs showed the c-probe still returned 0 bytes and printed only N_TTY poll/read-ret markers. This does not prove that 8250/serial_core/flip-buffer were not reached, because low-level printk on the same ttyS0 console can be suppressed or reentrant in the RX path. The `uart-irq` variant exhausted its trace limit before input release, and the late-min-commit variant was interrupted by the user before a complete rc/end, so neither is used as final RX evidence.
- `followup_counter_patch`: Replaced the printk trace with `Linux/patches/linux-npc-tty-rx-trace.patch`, managed by `Linux/scripts/npc-tty-rx-trace-patch.sh`. The patch uses exported `atomic64` counters for 8250 chars/pushes, `uart_insert_char` calls/inserted/ignored/overrun, tty flip pushes, flush calls, line-discipline received bytes, and N_TTY receive calls/bytes; it dumps snapshots only from `n_tty_poll`, `n_tty_read`, and `TIOCINQ/FIONREAD`. Validation on 2026-06-21: script `bash -n` PASS, `check-revert -> revert -> check -> apply -> check-revert` PASS, and incremental kernel `Image` build PASS. Runtime evidence `.github/task-runs/2026-06-16-npc-systemd-real-shell-uart-check/evidence/npc-systemd-tty-reader-c-probe-kernel-rx-counter/` used the patched kernel (`#5 Sun Jun 21 20:24:03 CST 2026`), reached c-probe raw mode, released at `cycle=675864409/commit=384572776`, and popped all 24 bytes through `cycle=678164409/commit=385812891`. All 257 counter snapshots stayed at zero for `8250_chars`, `8250_pushes`, `uart_calls`, `uart_inserted`, `flip_pushes`, `flush_calls`, `ntty_calls`, and `ntty_rcvd`; final probe output was `__NPC_TTY_READER_BYTES__:0` and `__NPC_TTY_C_PROBE_EMPTY__`. Therefore c-probe mode currently fails before Linux 8250 RX char handling, not in tty flip buffer or N_TTY read wakeup.
- `followup_irq_counter`: Extended the counter patch to `serial8250_handle_irq()` with IRQ/IIR/LSR/IER counters and regenerated it from the local `linux-6.6.tar.xz` baseline without resetting the active source tree. Validation again passed `bash -n`, `check-revert -> revert -> check -> apply -> check-revert`, and incremental kernel `Image` build. The run hit max cycles before done (`run.rc=1`), but 172 snapshots reached `8250_iir_rdi=24` while `8250_lsr_dr_nonzero=0`, `8250_chars_nonzero=0`, and `uart_calls_nonzero=0`; the last snapshot recorded `8250_irq_calls=805`, `8250_irq_handled=614`, `8250_iir_rdi=24`, `8250_iir_thri=590`, `8250_last_iir=0xc1`, `8250_last_lsr=0x60`, and `8250_last_ier=0x7`. Therefore the current c-probe failure is no longer simply “IRQ did not reach Linux”; Linux sees RX interrupt reason, but the LSR read used to decide RX draining never reports DR.
- `followup_read_lane_sideband`: Implemented the RTL fix for the IIR-RDI/LSR-DR mismatch. UART only clears RX when the aligned read includes lane0 RBR; byte-lane IIR and LSR reads no longer clear `rx_valid_q`. Page-table walks and IFU reads use all lanes. Runtime evidence in the current `npc-systemd-login-full-generators-enabled/` directory shows `Condition check resulted in Create System Users being skipped.` and no old `/dev/ttyS0` wait. The run still stopped before `__NPC_LOGIN_CHECK_DONE__ rc=0` at `cycles=2500000000`, `commits=1248307994`, `simulation frequency=226196 inst/s`, wrapper `run.rc=2`; the new first hard fault is `plymouth[64]: unhandled signal 4` with `badaddr: 0000000072f57543 cause: 2`. Disassembling `usr/lib/riscv64-linux-gnu/libply.so.5.0.0` around offset `0xc7b4` maps that instruction to `fmadd.d fa0,fa0,fa5,fa4`, so the next NPC-side blocker is RV64 FMA support, with udev/module-load/coldplug still visible as the later startup tail after the ISA fault is addressed.
- `notes`: This is not full Ubuntu 22.04 completion. It is reliable evidence that the UART RX/8250/tty path works, that a clean-kernel root shell can execute host-injected commands through the default root-shell ping wrapper, that generators-enabled full package rootfs reaches the real unit graph plus PID1 autocheck, that exact serial-getty can avoid the `/dev/ttyS0` device wait, and that sysusers can be preseeded out of the login critical path. The next decisive evidence should focus on NPC RV64 FMA (`FMADD/FMSUB/FNMSUB/FNMADD.{S,D}`) and then rerun the same narrow login marker, rather than continuing to debug the old IIR/LSR mismatch, stopping at package-presence checks, or widening the done marker.
